notes.title: Upcoming Enhancements and Exclusive Updates
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

I’m currently working on several improvements for our project. We will soon introduce a cosmetic system allowing you to customize your weapons with skins. We are also working on a general optimization of the game, along with a redesign of the interfaces for a better user experience. Finally, we are fixing numerous bugs to ensure a more stable game.

[b]Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for these updates![/b]

Best regards, 
Lamondille

notes.title: Thanks to you, the game continues: VIP Pass offered as a thank you!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

It is with great pleasure that I announce we have reached the necessary amount to[b] fund the servers for another year![/b] [h3]Thanks to your support[/h3]
We can continue to keep this game alive and offer a better experience to the entire community.

As a token of our appreciation, I am happy to offer you all a [b]VIP Pass[/b], which will be available in the coming months. This pass will give you access to free skins, a custom icon, and many other perks, including a special rank on our Discord server, and much more.

I sincerely thank you for your commitment.

You can join our Discord server via the link below to chat directly with me and discover the upcoming new features.
[url=https://discord.gg/fdpY8Jq7H3]Discord[/url]

Lamondille
CEO of Cyberstorm

notes.title: Server Shutdown and Future Plans for Cyberstorm
notes.content:
Dear players,

It is with regret that I announce the [b]shutdown of the Cyberstorm servers[/b]. I don't have the means to maintain such a large infrastructure. The Cyberstorm authentication servers cost me a lot of money and haven't generated enough revenue to sustain this project. However, I assure you that there will be an update that will drastically change the project. I can't give you a date, but being on my own, I plan to resume development in at least a year and a half. Thank you for your support. I hope to see you again.

Lamondille
